instrument_name: Colorado Wage Withholding Tax Guide (Revised January 2026), full read
figure_or_rule_carried: Resident: withhold CO on all wages except wages for services in another state that itself requires withholding. Nonresident: CO wages apportioned by days worked in CO (a day counts if majority of working time is in CO; travel to CO counts, departure does not); exempt table (rail, air carrier <=50% pay in CO, motor carrier, military, spouse, telecommuters outside CO). Returns quarterly/monthly/weekly by liability; W-2 to state by Jan 31. Guide has no reciprocity list and no local wage tax section. Employer liable whether or not withheld.
